name: Full shift
about: One working day in the stockroom: restock, incidents, orders, returns, a display stack, re-sorting, a messy stockroom, shelf cleaning and the end-of-day check. Each step has a plain-English task (what Nemotron reads) and a goal (what the controller checks).

steps.say: Morning restock (a box slips on the way)
steps.task: Restock the shelves. Heavy boxes go on the low shelf and light boxes go on the high shelf. On each shelf, order them left to right: red, green, blue.
Build a display: stack the light red box on top of the heavy red box. Leave the other boxes where they are.
Take the display down: put the light red box back on high_shelf_1.

steps.say: Re-sort: swap red and blue on the low shelf
steps.task: On the low shelf, swap the red box and the blue box. Leave every other box where it is.

steps.say: Put the low shelf back in order
steps.task: Put the low shelf back in order: left to right red, green, blue.
The stockroom is a mess. Restock the shelves: heavy boxes on the low shelf, light boxes on the high shelf, left to right red, green, blue.

steps.say: Clear the high shelf for cleaning
steps.task: The cleaners are coming: clear the high shelf and put its boxes in the dispatch bay (the front row of the table).

steps.say: End of day: everything back in place
steps.task: End of the day: put the boxes from the dispatch bay back on the high shelf, left to right red, green, blue, so every box is in its proper place.
